_meta.source: NCHS Health, United States (Table IDNotif) · CDC NNDSS annual summary via WONDER
_meta.name: Syphilis, Primary and secondary
_meta.note: Annual reported primary and secondary syphilis incidence from NCHS and CDC NNDSS; congenital and other stages are excluded. The case definition changed in 2018. Rates through 2019 are NCHS's; rates from 2020 are the NNDSS final count divided by the Census July 1 resident population (FRED POPTHM), using a later population vintage (about 1% higher denominator). This is not always the same construction: IDNotif excludes populations of jurisdictions where a disease was not notifiable or data were unavailable; STD rates before 1991 use civilian population. Selected years before 1988 are not interpolated.
_meta.breaks: 2018 CSTE case-definition revision; congenital syphilis excluded from this row.
